diagnosis: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, GCB phenotype by Hans algorithm.
stage: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage II bulky disease, with cervical and mediastinal nodal disease above the diaphragm only and a 12 cm mediastinal mass.
biology: Double-hit lymphoma because MYC and BCL2 rearrangements are detected by FISH. It is also double-expressor by IHC because MYC is 80% and BCL2 is 90%, but the FISH-defined double-hit biology is the key classification.
prognosis: Use IPI and CNS-IPI. Elevated LDH and bulky disease are adverse, and double-hit genetics are a major high-risk biological feature.
first_line_treatment: Curative-intent intensive immunochemotherapy. DA-EPOCH-R or clinical trial enrollment is appropriate; R-CHOP alone is generally not preferred for rearrangement-defined double-hit lymphoma.
cns_risk: Calculate CNS-IPI and consider CNS prophylaxis because double-hit biology and elevated LDH raise concern, although kidney/adrenal, testicular, and breast sites are absent. Prophylaxis should be individualized based on renal function and fitness.
response_assessment: Use FDG PET-CT with Lugano/Deauville criteria, especially end-of-treatment PET.
missing_information: CSF assessment if CNS staging is pursued
